messages:
emma: Quick sketch for a compact PLG experiment: 'Case-led launch' vs 'Tool-led launch'. Short LinkedIn post + 25-min live demo + 48h tiered credits. Idea: anchor the narrative to a short customer case (3 benchmarks) and measure activation lift from story framing. A/B the creative, route signups into two onboarding flows with distinct prompt-packs and a tiny activation challenge. Thoughts?
noah: Strong. Proposed KPIs: demo->signup rate, signup->first_success(<24h), pct_using_prompt_pack by day3. Analytics can do a cohort panel with these metrics.
tara: Copy drafts: Case-led: 'How Acme cut inference cost 40% and shipped a support bot in 2 weeks  Live demo + starter credits.' Tool-led: 'One runtime. Multiple deployments. Quick demo + credits.' CTAs: 'Claim starter credits' vs 'Run the quick demo'.
kai: Routing plan: add utm_param=caseA|toolB and auto-tag user.cohort. For qualified routing to SDR: company email && tokens_7d>=1000 -> hot queue. Otherwise, automated nurture. Ops  can you wire webhook to #sales-inbound?
ops-bot: Webhook + route created. Example payload: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/routes -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"email":"{{email}}","utm":"caseA","cohort":"caseA"}'``` -> posts to #sales-inbound. :white_check_mark:
emma: Onboarding differences: Case flow includes 3 mini-case prompt templates (support summarizer, triage classifier, SLA-aware responder) and a short walkthrough showing before/after metrics. Tool flow includes 3 minimal runnable templates + quick infra notes. Both flows get 48h credits but differ in the nudge sequence.
noah: Analytics event spec: emit 'prompt_pack_claim' and 'first_success' with property 'cohort' and 'template_id'. Also track 'credits_usage' with amounts so we can measure real engagement.
tara: Draft LinkedIn posts: Case-led: 'See how a small team shipped an SLA-safe support bot & cut per-token cost. Live demo + credits.' Tool-led: 'One API for hosted/dedicated/private inference. Quick demo + free credits.' Webinar blurb: '25-min demo + 10-min Q&A  Wed 9am PT. Limited seats.'
kai: SDR flow: For hot leads send to #sales-inbound with company, tokens_7d, cohort, use_case. SLA for first touch <=4h. If user runs first prompt within 12h mark high priority.
ops-bot: Tracking snippet for the onboarding challenge: `<script>track('first_success',{cohort:'caseA',template:'support_summarizer'});</script>` Also credit grant example: `<script>emit('credit_grant',{cohort:'caseA',amount:2500});</script>`
emma: Timeline: copy + landing by Tue EOD, routing live Wed AM, demo Thu 9am PT, credits active at signup. Tara please assemble prompt-packs and tag versions in /docs/prompt-templates/case-launch-1777777777.md
tara: Will add 3 templates per flow with short examples and a one-click run snippet. Also adding a 1-question post-run survey: "Did this output solve your problem?" yes/no.
noah: Dashboard mock uploaded to /drive/marketing/case-launch-1777/dashboard-v1.png. I'll add cohort filters & cohort-level retention curves.
kai: Small experiment variant: withhold 500 of credits until first_success to test deferred incentive. Add third cohort caseC. Need messaging clarity to avoid churn.
emma: Good call. Add cohort 'caseC' in routing and show clear value prop on landing. Everyone: keep replies here for quick signoff. :rocket:
